lastCompletedStory.title: Resolve the orchestrator pid via pgrep -P with a non-silent unresolved-pid event

nextStoryContext: US-002 reworked makeResolvePidFn to use ORCH_PID_MARKER (from src/tmux/session.ts, introduced US-001) + pgrep -P instead of pgrep -f <sessionId>. Two new helpers were extracted: readWrapperPid(pidFilePath) and resolveChildViaPgrep(wrapperPid). The tick path (handleOneTick) no longer uses readSessionIdFn; it now calls resolvePidFn() directly (no args). OrchRecycleWatchOptions.resolvePidFn is now () => number | null. readSessionIdFn in the options is deprecated (silently ignored) but kept for backward compat. An injectable emitEventFn seam was added: fires a structured JSON line when the marker is consumed but pid does not resolve. The integration test (test/integration/orch-recycle-pid-resolve.test.ts) spawns a real bash wrapper with pgrep -P and SIGTERMs the child.

officialDocsValidated.summary: pgrep -P restricts matches to children of the given ppid. Exit 0 = match found, exit 1 = no match. Implementation guards (result.status ?? 1) !== 0 correctly handle both cases.
